prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A modern, abstract close-up photograph featuring a series of sleek, horizontal metallic or glass elements with a reflective blue tint, arranged in a staggered vertical stack on the left side of the frame. The background is softly out of focus, dominated by a clean, white surface with a large, partially visible corporate logo in blue text, reading "Gene..." and accompanied by smaller, blurred gray text beneath it. The composition is minimalist and contemporary, with a cool color palette of whites, silvers, and deep blues. The lighting is bright and even, creating crisp reflections and a sense of high-tech sophistication. The camera angle is straight-on, with a shallow depth of field that emphasizes the sharpness and texture of the foreground elements while rendering the background text and environment as a soft blur, evoking a professional, corporate, and futuristic atmosphere.
